text.tspan: local-exec runs where Terraform runs; remote-exec runs on the new machine
If a creation-time provisioner fails, the resource is
marked TAINTED → destroyed + recreated on the next apply
Last resort (HashiCorp docs). Prefer: user_data / cloud-init,
Packer-baked AMIs, Ansible after apply, EKS add-ons / Helm,
Both run only at CREATE (or at destroy with when = destroy), not on every apply, and Terraform can't plan or
track what they did. Changing the command later does nothing to existing resources.
